about: Key moments for chapter 19, seeded by the project as a starting point.

jobs.prompt: Medium shot in an underground cafeteria deep inside a mountain, where two large wall screens pose as windows showing a sunlit view over low city roofs and trees. The man from reference image 1 sits at a table, glancing sideways in mild alarm at a small palm-sized security drone hovering half a meter from his right ear. Across from him, the young man from reference image 2 looks on, relaxed and amused, with a few more small drones in the air behind him. Cool artificial light mixed with the screens' false daylight.

Wide view down a carved stone tunnel to a large ornamented wooden door. To the left of the door, a painted mural of a hippopotamus reading a book in a marsh with green trees and a blue sky; to the right, a painted mural of a hamster sitting at a computer. Both murals balance playful cartoon charm with an air of mystery. A man and a young man, seen from behind, approach the door. Warm lamplight on rough rock walls.

Medium-wide interior of a grand underground library. On one side, a towering two-level wall of paper books, with a walkway along the upper level and narrow book-lined openings leading into a maze. On the other side, open tables and a row of computer terminals. A woman librarian in a simple long robe plugs a data cable into a terminal and hands the other end to the young man from reference image 1, who holds out his hand device with eager curiosity. A man stands just behind him, seen from behind. Warm amber lamplight.

Medium shot beside a tall wall of paper books in a warm underground library. The man from reference image 1 stands holding an open book of drawings of underground rooms, looking down in surprise as a small wheeled serving robot hands him tea in a fully sealed cup with a straw. In the background, far from the shelves, the young man from reference image 2 sits at a table with an open teacup. Warm amber lamplight, dust floating in the air.

Medium close shot at a library table. The man from reference image 1 and the young man from reference image 2 sit side by side sipping tea, both staring intently at a hand device propped on the table, its screen turned away from the viewer and casting a soft glow on their faces. A data cable runs from the device to a terminal. Two meters behind them, a curious woman librarian in a long robe hovers quietly, hands clasped. Tall bookshelves blur in the warm background.
